_readme: Los Medanos College's eLumen catalog (S600, SkyWhirlpool). 54 of its 83 records fail, about 37 on one shape: the record names the 60-unit degree total and a GE pattern (Cal-GETC on the transfer degrees, LMC's local GE on the A.A. and A.S.) with no units for it, so the scorer cannot add the degree up. A reconcile step must cite the catalog's own words, so this read prints what two transfer and two local degree pages say about general education, electives and the total.

questions.ge_units: What each degree page says about its general education pattern and how many units it carries.
questions.electives: Whether the page says electives make up the rest of the 60 units, and in what words.
